title: Memory
subtitle: Choose what the assistant remembers and how long chats are kept.
conversationHistoryDesc: Keep your chats so you can come back to them. Turning this off stops saving new chats.
agentMemoryDesc: Let the assistant suggest things to remember from chats. When off, it makes no suggestions.
autoAcceptDesc: Save high-confidence suggestions without asking. Default is off.
purge.title: Delete data
purge.help: Deleting permanently erases these records. This cannot be undone.
purge.forgottenDesc: Permanently delete all previously forgotten memory records from storage.
purge.rejectedDesc: Permanently delete rejected and expired suggestions.
purge.historyDesc: Permanently delete chats that aren't pinned.
purge.confirm: Are you sure you want to purge selected data? This permanent deletion cannot be undone.
